tiers.name: Rags & Flayed Skins
tiers.description: Filthy tunics and crude hides offering no protection

tiers.name: Padded Leather
tiers.description: Boiled leather and stitched gambeson. Absorbs d2 damage.

tiers.name: Rusty Chainmail
tiers.description: Interlocking iron rings. Absorbs d4 damage. +2 DR on Agility tests (including defense). Cannot wield Powers or read scrolls.

tiers.name: Dented Plate Mail
tiers.description: Heavy hammered plate. Absorbs d6 damage. +4 DR on Agility tests, defense is DR+2. Cannot wield Powers or read scrolls.

shield.name: Shield
shield.description: Wood and iron round shield. Absorbs 1 damage or can be sacrificed/broken to entirely negate 1 attack.
